title: Filtration spectrum data grid inside Figure 5.74 Membrane characteristics
notes: Unnumbered table; Tp<physical-page>-<sequence> is a service locator, not a printed table number.
This grid is the bottom band of the printed diagram Figure 5.74 (filtration spectrum). It is printed as a ruled table and is transcribed as a table, not as a figure description.

Transcriber layout note: the printed top row 'Mol.Wt.' carries both the row label and the four column values; it is used here as the header row. The rows below read 'Pressure / [psi] / [bar]' in one label cell (three printed lines) and 'Microns' in the last row.
Printed caption below the figure: 'Figure 5.74  Membrane characteristics'.
Ranges run high-to-low as printed (1,000-400 psi and 68.9-27.6 bar, then 600-100, 200-70, 125-15 psi and 41.4-6.9, 13.8-4.8, 8.6-1 bar). Order retained; no re-sorting.
Pressure is preset twice in different units ([psi] and [bar]) for the same column; both rows are retained.

The classes named in the diagram above the grid (Reverse Osmosis, Nanofiltration, Ultrafiltration, Microfiltration, Particle Filtration) are diagram labels, not table cells, and are not part of this table.

Transcriber note: the figure's vertical column separators run upward past the grid, so they cross the top edge of this region; the grid's own top rule is the first horizontal line inside it. Nothing from the ellipse diagram above is included as a value.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 360-480 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: The grid was read from 480 dpi crops of the data band. Mol.Wt., pressure and micron values were checked digit by digit, including '68.9-27.6' and '13.8-4.8'.
